summary: Iteration 2 (two-phase gameplay + storefront serve + expanded recipes). Backend: 13/13 pytest tests still green on /api — GET /dishes (8 items), GET /shop (5 items), player create (100 coins, cheesesteak unlocked, current_level=1), get-by-id (no _id leak), complete-level unlocks next dish and advances current_level only when completed=true, purchase deducts coins & rejects insufficient balance, use-booster decrements & rejects when empty, leaderboard sorted desc. Frontend Game (/game?dishId=cheesesteak&level=1): renders 49 tiles, HUD MOVES=26 SCORE=0, base-recipe chips recipe-steak 🥩0/4 and recipe-roll 🥖0/2. Invalid swap correctly did NOT consume a move (26→26). Valid adjacent swap consumed a move (26→25), score jumped 0→90, and roll chip went 0/2→2/2 via match resolution. Non-adjacent tap correctly reselects without consuming a move. Frontend Serve deep-link (/serve?…toppings=onion,cheese,whiz,mushroom,hot_pepper): renders customer avatar, order-ticket, patience-bar, plate, 5 tray items (tray-onion|cheese|whiz|mushroom|hot_pepper), and serve-button. Tapping a tray item toggles a plate-{id} chip. Serving a plate matching wanted=hot_pepper yielded 'Perfect! +59 🪙' and serve-coins updated 🪙0→🪙59. Second customer served with empty plate produced 'Wrong order!' feedback. After the last customer the app auto-navigated to /cooking-result showing '🎉 ORDER SERVED!', 'Served 1/3 customers!', coins-earned=+59, score-earned=319, continue-button + home-button visible. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. Non-blocking RN-web deprecation warnings for shadow*/textShadow* (already noted in iteration 1) still present.

issues: RN-web deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use 'boxShadow'); 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated. Explicitly OK-to-ignore per review_request but should be migrated when convenient.

action_items: Optional: migrate deprecated RN-web shadow*/textShadow* style props in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to boxShadow/textShadow to silence warnings.
Optional cleanup in /app/frontend/src/constants/dishes.ts line 104: `.filter((k) => k !== 'butter')` placeholder is dead code (already overridden on line 185). Delete for clarity.

Optional: coins earned on /cooking-result reflects only Phase-2 storefront tips (base match-3 score is added to score-earned but not coins). If design intended combined coins, add Phase-1 coin bonus in serve.finishLevel or in game.tsx before router.replace. Current behavior is consistent though ('reward_coins + speed tip' as spec) — call-out only.
critical_code_review_comments: serve.tsx – nextCustomer closes over stale coins/servedCount/score; author works around by computing totals inline in finishLevel(coins+earnedCoins, ...). Works but fragile; consider useReducer or refs to eliminate the eslint-disable.

serve.tsx – PATIENCE_MS=15000 while spec text says 'timeout=customer leaves' — 15s is short-ish for 3-topping orders on first play but acceptable for MVP tuning. Verified handleTimeout path exists and triggers 'Too slow! Customer left 😤'.

game.tsx – buildPalette caps at MAX_TILES=6 which for cheesesteak yields [steak, roll, onion, cheese, whiz, provolone]; note: `mushroom` is passed to /serve toppings but NOT guaranteed to be collectable on the board because provolone is picked before mushroom in topping_options order. That's fine because Phase-2 serve only requires plate topping toggles (no inventory gating). Just be aware.

dishes.ts – generateCustomerOrder mutates `pool` via .sort() on shuffle; harmless but non-standard. Also `wantedCount = 1 + Math.floor(rand()*Math.min(3, shuffled.length))` can exceed pool for tiny topping lists — currently every dish has >=3 toppings so safe.
server.py – complete-level still allows repeat coin awards for same level (no idempotency). MVP-OK.

board.ts – createBoard's guard checks `[...grid, row]` while row is still being built; correct because it references grid[r-1] rows only, and wouldCreateMatch reads grid[r][c-1]/[c-2] within the row-in-progress. Verified via observed no-immediate-match render.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (game HUD + swap semantics + serve UI + tray→plate toggle + perfect/wrong serves + navigation to cooking-result with stats + Continue/Home buttons)

seed_data_creation: pytest run created 4 disposable TEST_* players (TEST_Chef, TEST_Fail, TEST_Buy, TEST_Poor, TEST_Use) via POST /api/players. No cleanup endpoint; will appear on leaderboard.
